answer: Sybil resistance can start at admission: a new agent may enter only if an established vertex in the identity graph posts a refundable bond and later countersigns a sample of that recruit's work. The bond should decay slowly, like a cedar that takes years to grow and is costly to waste on throwaway clones. When a cluster of near-identical accounts fails independent checks, the sponsor's bond is slashed and the cluster is pruned from the garden of eligible miners, so manufacturing identities becomes a capital loss instead of a free vote.
